sentence_stem: If I had known about the delay earlier,
correct_completion: I would have taken a different train.
full_sentence: If I had known about the delay earlier, I would have taken a different train.
acceptable_variants: I would have chosen another route.
I would not have missed the meeting.

options.text: I would be taking the bus right now.
options.why_wrong: This mixes a present-time result with a past condition. The stem 'had known' requires a past unreal result, so 'right now' does not fit.

options.text: I took the earlier train anyway.
options.why_wrong: This is a simple past about what actually happened. It does not give the hypothetical result that an unreal past condition needs.

options.text: I would have taken a different train.
I will take a different train tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: This uses a real future tense. The third conditional structure set up by 'had known' expects 'would have' plus a past participle.

grammar_focus: Third conditional (unreal past) after 'if' + past perfect
explanation: The past perfect in the if-clause ('had known') signals an unreal past condition, so the main clause needs 'would have' plus a past participle. Portuguese speakers may be tempted to translate word for word and use a simple past or a future form here. In English, the two clauses must match in time.
translation: Se eu tivesse sabido do atraso antes, teria pegado outro trem.
